ev.q: This report summarizes mpox surveillance data reported to CDC during October 1, 2023–April 30, 2024.
Clade II Mpox Surveillance Update — United States, October 2023–April 2024

equity.level_reason: Race/ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation and age describe the composition of cases; the race shift across periods is a change in case shares, not an outcome measured per group, and is not framed as a disparity.

level_alternative.reason: The percentage-point change in Black and Hispanic shares of cases across periods could be read as group-specific results by race/ethnicity.

equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity shares of cases compared with the earlier outbreak period (from a CDC web page); gender identity and sexual orientation largely missing; AI/AN and NH/PI collapsed into another race.

notes: Earlier-period comparison figures (May 2022–September 2023) come from CDC's own surveillance web page. Vaccine coverage among persons at risk (39%, 25%) is cited from an earlier report. Hospitalization among vaccinated cases (1%) is reported without a formal comparison or VE.
view_issues: The Summary says cases 'remain significantly lower', but no test, p-value or CI appears anywhere; read as colloquial. Deaths are given as five patients and as 0.3% of cases.
